SELECT parent_id
FROM (
  SELECT parent_id, lower(action) AS action FROM "drugbank_carriers_actions"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT parent_id, lower(action) FROM "drugbank_targets_actions"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT parent_id, lower(action) FROM "drugbank_transporters_actions"
)
WHERE action IN ('inhibitor','binder','substrate')
GROUP BY parent_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT action) = 3
LIMIT 50;
